title: CrmSignRequestOutput
description: The request's status projection (signers + audit). Signer tokens are minted and signers are EMAILED on a genuinely new id — which is why a replay fork must be served the recorded outcome, never re-executed. A refusal at the surface (tenant guard, link validation, cap, tombstone) is a TYPED node failure, never a success with an empty entity.

signRequest.description: The signRequest row as the surface projects it (host bookkeeping columns `tenantId`/`orgId`/`createdBy`/`updatedBy` stripped).
